author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Learn how to use Google Flow Music to create your own AI-generated songs from start to finish. In this step-by-step tutorial, I’ll show you how to generate music with a simple prompt, customize lyrics and vocals, remix sections, extend songs, create covers, and more.

You’ll also learn how to turn an image into music, use voice mode to describe changes, download your finished songs and stems, and even transform your music into an AI-generated music video.

Host: Kevin Stratvert

📚 RESOURCES
- Get started with Google Flow Music: https://www.flowmusic.app
-Playlist with full songs featured in this video: https://www.flowmusic.app/Kevstrat
